thesis: The setup is a pullback in a gap-driven rally, bought into a risk-off tape (VIX 31.34 at the 0.991 percentile, QQQ below its 50 and 200-day averages). The uptrend rests on one 22% earnings gap, and since the 713.74 high the stock has made lower highs and lost about 5%. Valuation is unknown because the profile is entirely null, so nobody can say the re-rating is supported. Sequential revenue has flattened and the stock is up about 23% in 30 days, which leaves room for mean reversion. A stop at 647 sits only about 1 ATR below entry. In a high-VIX tape, a gap-fill toward 620-650 can take that stop on a single gap-down open, and reward is capped at the 52-week high.
